General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These parts fix the shifting problems with the Transmission Shifter.
NOTE: The Locating Lever Bolt goes inside the upper transmission housing and guides the shifter’s movement through gear changes. When this bolt gets worn or broken, shifting the gears will become difficult and replacing the bolt will be necessary.
Includes Lock Washer
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Lever Locating Bolt (12mm)
Qty 1 – Lock Washer
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1990 – 1995 All Models
